items.text: Short-term commerce courses of three to six months are worth paying for only when they teach a skill that job notices name, such as accounting software, GST basics, spreadsheets or e-commerce operations, and when you finish with work you can show.
Read ten notices for the role you want, pick the one skill they repeat and learn it free first.
Check the provider on official pages and ask past learners what job they got.
